svg.title: 03 / Selected projects
svg.desc: Hobo (SHOPIFY APP · AI): An embedded Shopify app that adds an AI chat assistant to the storefront, answering shoppers from the store's own catalog and content and handing the conversation to a human agent when needed. Key features: Agentic AI chat with streamed responses; Semantic product & content search (RAG); Human handoff for support conversations; Real-time catalog sync via Shopify webhooks. Stack: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Qdrant, OpenAI API. Coup (RESERVATION PWA): A full-stack Progressive Web App for managing and reserving coworking space at Pardis Technology Park. Members browse available spaces, pick a seat or meeting room, and book it online from mobile or desktop. Key features: Online seat reservation; Meeting room booking; Coworking space management; Installable, responsive PWA. Stack: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, PWA, Docker. OIEC (ENTERPRISE · AI): An enterprise full-stack app for processing product information and converting legacy product codes to a new structure, with Flowise AI pipelines automating part of a review-heavy workflow. Key features: Product information management; Legacy product code conversion; AI-assisted processing with Flowise; Dockerized server deployment. Stack: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, Flowise, Docker. INOTEX (EVENT PWA · AI): A Progressive Web App that brings the exhibitors, companies, event programs and news of the INOTEX exhibition into one place, with an AI chatbot that answers visitor questions. Key features: Exhibitor & company directory; Event programs and news; AI chatbot for visitor questions; Installable, responsive PWA. Stack: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Flowise, Docker. Elixia (AI · FITNESS PWA): A fitness Progressive Web App that uses AI to recommend personalized workout and nutrition plans based on each user's information and goals, delivered as an installable, app-like experience for daily use. Key features: AI workout plan recommendations; Nutrition plan recommendations; Personalized to user goals; Installable mobile PWA. Stack: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, PWA, AI Integration.
